build_device_mesh_1d: build a 1D DeviceMesh from a CUDA device type and a list of device ranks
build_device_mesh_2d: build a 2D DeviceMesh from a CUDA device type and a nested list of device ranks
create_distributed_tensor_shard_col: create a distributed tensor sharding a 4x4 tensor across columns using Shard(dim=1)
create_distributed_tensor_shard_row: create a distributed tensor sharding a 4x4 tensor across rows using Shard(dim=0)
visualize_sharding_dtensor: visualize the sharding layout of a distributed tensor with DeviceMesh and Shard or Replicate strategies
